resetAllDescription: Today's checkmarks will be removed. Your steps will stay unchanged.
noSteps: This routine does not have any steps yet.
noRoutinesTodayDescription: None of your routines are set to show up today. Check a routine's days in Edit to change that.
deleteRoutineDescription: The routine and its steps will be permanently deleted.
emptyDescription: Add a few steps you want to keep close every day.
mobileOnly: This app works only on smartphones.
allRoutinesDescription: See every routine, including ones not scheduled for today.
exportDataDescription: Save your routines to a file.
importDataDescription: Restore your routines from a backup.
importDescription: Everything you have now will be replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone.
importFailed: That file is not a Routines backup.
installAppDescription: Add Routines to your home screen.
installAppUnavailable: Use your browser menu, then “Add to Home Screen”.
updateAppDescription: Fetch the newest version and reload.
updateAppConfirmDescription: The app will reload. A backup of your routines is saved first.
restoreSnapshotDescription: Put back the routines saved before the last update.
appLockDescription: Ask for your fingerprint before opening.
appLockUnsupported: No fingerprint unlock on this device.
appLockNotice: A convenience lock only — it does not encrypt your routines.
appLockEncryptedNotice: Your routines are encrypted with a key derived from your fingerprint. If it stops working, your data cannot be recovered — export a backup as insurance.
appLockFailed: Setting up the lock did not work.
unlockFailed: That did not work. Try again.
eraseDataWarningDescription: Your data is encrypted and can only be read with a working fingerprint unlock. Since that isn't available right now, turning off the lock permanently erases it — there is no way to recover it afterwards.
resetSettingsDescription: Put language and app lock back to their defaults. Routines are kept.
resetSettingsConfirmDescription: Language and app lock go back to their defaults. Your routines and today's checkmarks are not touched.
